candidates: S3 bucket name referenced by OUTPUT_BUCKET in the IaC template for UploaderFunction
answer.explanation: Every UploaderFunction invocation in the window fails with NoSuchBucket on PutObject to OUTPUT_BUCKET, while CrudApiFunction, ThumbnailerFunction and CompressionFunction complete normally. NoSuchBucket means the configured bucket name does not exist, which points to a misconfigured bucket name rather than missing permissions (that would surface as AccessDenied, so IAM is unlikely). The most likely cause is the OUTPUT_BUCKET environment variable on the live function, with the IaC template as the intended-state source to check. The handler code itself is only a secondary candidate. No tool outputs beyond the logs were available, so the environment variable value and template were not directly verified.
